segments.name: Corporate Financial Services and Maintenance Leasing
segments.description: Provides leasing, installment lending and maintenance leasing services to corporate customers, mainly in Japan.
segments.evidence: Corporate Financial Services and Maintenance Leasing Segment profits increased 12% to ¥100,740 million compared to the previous fiscal year primarily due to increases in operating leases revenues and equity in net income of equity method investments.

segments.name: Real Estate
products: Sales of goods and real estate
segments.description: Develops, leases, sells and manages real estate for corporate and other customers.
segments.evidence: Real Estate Segment profits increased 11% to ¥78,509 million compared to the previous fiscal year primarily due to increases in services income and equity in net income of equity method investments, partially offset by a decrease in operating leases revenues.

segments.name: PE Investment and Concession
segments.description: Holds private equity investments and concession businesses, providing capital and support to investee companies.
segments.evidence: The ten segments are Corporate Financial Services and Maintenance Leasing, Real Estate, PE Investment and Concession, Environment and Energy, Insurance, Banking and Credit, Aircraft and Ships, ORIX USA, ORIX Europe, and Asia and Australia.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay ORIX for leases, loans, insurance premiums, asset management and other financial and operating services.
revenueModel.evidence: Other revenues include revenues that are not in the scope of revenue from contracts with customers, such as life insurance premiums and related investment income, operating leases, finance revenues that include interest income, and others.

changes.text: In 2026 the company changed its operating segment structure, with new segment information to be disclosed the following fiscal year.
changes.evidence: Effective April 1, 2026, we changed our operating segments used by our chief operating decision maker for allocating resources and assessing performance.

changes.text: In 2026 ORIX agreed to transfer all shares of ORIX Bank Corporation, a Banking and Credit segment company.
changes.evidence: On April 27, 2026, the Company entered into a share transfer agreement with Daiwa Next Bank, Ltd. to transfer all shares in ORIX Bank Corporation, a consolidated subsidiary of the Company
